spans.s: कु—गणिन् mfn. belonging to an evil set of people, Lalit.
कु—गति f. ‘wrong path’, deviation from the path of righteousness, Buddh.
कु—गो m. a miserable or weak bull, R. vi, 112, 6.
कु—ग्रह m. an unpropitious planet (five are reckoned, viz. Maṅgala, Ravi, Śani, Rāhu, and Ketu), Subh.
कु—ग्राम m. a petty village (without a Rājā, an Agnihotrin, a physician, a rich man, or a river).
